name: Radial music visualizer
description: Circular music visualizer driven by the project audio (studio.level, beat-pulse fallback): a spinning vinyl or your artwork that pumps on the bass, a mirrored ring of spectrum bars/line/dots in a colour sweep, glow that follows loudness and particles that fly outward faster on kicks, plus track title and artist; use for music uploads, lo-fi loops and DJ promos (full-frame or transparent overlay).
